priorExposure: The reviewer has already inspected the catalogue, its cycles, the foundation review, the first reconstruction and the negative numerical case. This is not a blind or preregistered classification.
reviewUnit: One complete legacy incoming parent assertion, including its direction, mechanism labels, lifecycle, necessity, weight and carrier thresholds.

decisions.retain-as-description: Adopt an explicitly scoped definitional or contextual relation. This does not retain an asserted physical cause, numeric weight or measured threshold.
decisions.replace-with-rule: Replace a flat assertion with identified joint rule specifications and their conditional stages. Mapping is not scientific equivalence or successful rule execution.
decisions.withhold: Complete the internal assessment but adopt no active edge: the reviewed sources leave an obligation unresolved or the asserted implication fails in the stated scope. Withholding is not proof of physical absence.

evidenceRules: Bind each decision to the exact legacy record and a source-specific locator or a scoped counterexample.
Use a manuscript as evidence of an author's definition or proposal, not independent empirical confirmation.
A claim-specific sufficient implication can be rejected by a counterexample only within its declared assumptions; do not universalize a bounded negative case.
Treat missing model variables, interventions or source support as unresolved; do not infer falsity from failure to locate a publication.
Use the descriptive kind for adopted definition and rule-incidence relations. Physical relations require an independently specified mechanism, context and admissible test.
Record legacy lifecycle separately from the proposed semantic kind. A modulation label does not by itself establish feedback.
Review weight, necessity and threshold provenance separately. Do not make unsupported numbers meaningful by normalizing them.
Do not select dispositions to produce a desired cycle count, connected component count or preferred geometry.
Require a specific alternative and a revisiting condition for every decision. Internal review completion and scientific support status remain separate.
acceptance: Every one of the 84 Level-0 assertions receives one locatable decision, endpoint-specific reasoning, a declared replacement or withholding, quantitative disposition and an explicit remaining test. Other levels remain pending. Independent scientific review is not claimed.
